title: Arctura Family Registry
description: A status-aware index of Arctura product, community, evidence, and governance surfaces.

items.title: Arctura Observatory
items.summary: The public signal, evidence, constellation, and field index for the Arctura family.

items.title: Arctura Energy
items.summary: A wind-energy retrofit and validation concept focused on aerodynamic performance, asset protection, and field-ready deployment.
items.boundary: Public claims remain limited to source-backed development and validation framing until product ownership, results, and permissions are documented.

items.title: Arctura Health
items.summary: A specialty-care referral-recovery workflow surface for finding stalled referrals, coordinating next actions, and tracking completed care.
items.boundary: This registry records the public product surface only. Source-repository ownership, compliance claims, and integrations require separate verification.

items.title: Arctura Frequency
items.summary: A non-clinical wellness and reflection experience using ritual, focus, and self-guidance language.
items.boundary: Non-medical. No diagnostic, treatment, physiological, or outcome claim is implied.

items.title: Biohacking Frequency Tools
items.summary: An early frequency/biohacking concept retained as a historical design and messaging artifact.
items.boundary: The public surface contains legacy language that requires review before promotion or commercial use.

items.title: Arctura Protocol
items.summary: An early-stage documentation and evidence surface for Lightning-to-EVM verification concepts and agent-payment infrastructure.
items.boundary: Early-stage. Audit, security, contract-source, and deployment states must be explicit before any production claim.

items.title: ARCTURA (TURA)
items.summary: A Base ERC-20 token record added to the Observatory as an on-chain provenance artifact.
items.boundary: This registry entry records public on-chain metadata observed on BaseScan. It is not an investment recommendation, market analysis, liquidity statement, utility promise, endorsement, or instruction to buy, sell, transfer, or hold TURA. The launch attribution to Clawlett is user-provided and has not been independently verified in this record.

items.title: Autonomous Resource Management
items.summary: A proposed policy and audit layer for agent identity, mandate, permissions, resources, execution, and receipt records.
items.boundary: No autonomous financial, medical, legal, or other high-impact action is implied. Human approval and policy gates remain required.

items.title: Arctura Collective
items.summary: A disclosed registry of contributors, disciplines, agents, mandates, and contribution paths.

items.title: Arcturian Council
items.summary: A disclosed, multi-perspective decision-support and scenario-framing service with sources, uncertainty labels, and human review.
items.boundary: Not professional advice, not prophecy, and not an autonomous decision-maker.
